Messages.Author: Nikolaj Wendt
Messages.Body:
If i want to use the "set range" effect of the sniper rifle i have to
use the weapon for the first round.

Do i have to use it at least once (so i can use other strikes on
additional strikes) or is it the only type of strike i can use that
round even if i have additional strikes???

--
Posted via Mailgate.ORG Server - http://www.Mailgate.ORG

Messages.Author: John
Messages.Body:
"Nikolaj Wendt" <niko...@hotmail.com> wrote in message

> If i want to use the "set range" effect of the sniper rifle i have to
> use the weapon for the first round.
>
> Do i have to use it at least once (so i can use other strikes on
> additional strikes) or is it the only type of strike i can use that
> round even if i have additional strikes???

If you use the "set range" effect of the Sniper Rifle you must use the
Sniper Rifle on your first strike in the first round of combat. If you have
additional strikes you can do with them as you please (including using the
sniper rifle again)

-JP

maneuver at superior) by Blood Brother B with another Sniper Rifle set

question is, is Blood Brother B considered to be blocking?
